decision: Remove the three process.env reads from makeFlowableClient (lines 264/269/274 of src/core/flowable-client.ts): baseUrl gets a literal default 'http://flowable:8082/flowable-rest/service', adminUser gets literal default 'admin', adminPassword throws if absent. Signature (config?: Partial<FlowableClientConfig>) is unchanged — zero breaking callers when bridge-runner.ts and bridge-smoke-runner.ts are updated to pass an explicit config built from local env reads. A NEW ci/checks/no-env-in-core.sh (owner T-0163) is created that scans the full src/core/ tree with positive and negative self-tests; keyed-digest-core-purity.sh (owner T-0143, frozen) is NOT modified. package.json fitness script gains '&& bash ci/checks/no-env-in-core.sh'.

rejected_alternatives.option: Extend keyed-digest-core-purity.sh to cover all of src/core/
rejected_alternatives.why_not: That file carries header '# T-0143 ·'. frozen-checks-immutable.sh reads ownership from BASE_REF and blocks modification of any ci/checks/*.sh not owned by the current task (FF-FCI1). Modifying it on task/T-0163 would produce a CI failure.
Rename is a CDMRT diff-filter event. The frozen guard treats rename as modification of a foreign check (owner T-0143) — same FF-FCI5 failure as direct edit.

Adds a new file and indirection with no benefit. Both bridge-runner.ts and bridge-smoke-runner.ts already read other env vars locally. Inline env reads in the same function match the pattern already used by lifecycle-bridge.ts and are the simplest change.

rejected_alternatives.option: Make baseUrl a required parameter (no literal default)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Breaking change for tests and scenarios that rely on the container default. Spec §2.1 explicitly preserves the literal default; only the env read is removed.

rejected_alternatives.option: Keep adminUser as an env read (it is not a secret)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: NF-1 prohibits any process.env read in src/core/, not just secret reads. 'admin' is a public Flowable default; a literal is more accurate and removes the env dependency entirely.
